newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain 96 central gov't deficit will hit 3.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Spain 96 central gov't deficit will hit 3.5 pct.

text.p: The Spanish central government's 1996 budget deficit will reach the 3.5 percent objective without more cuts, Jose Folgado, deficit secretary, said on Tuesday.

"We will reach the public deficit target (for the central government) of 3.5 percent without any further cuts except light touch-ups, if they prove necessary, or for imponderables," Folgado told a congressional budget committee.
Spain's budget deficit goal for 1996 is 3.5 percent of gross domestic product (GDP) for the central government and 4.4 percent overall.
Folgado said the central government deficit would be 2.63 trillion pesetas in 1996, or 3.5 percent of GDP.
Folgado also said the "budget is being carried out with rigour."
